## Updraft 0.7.4

- **Automatic updates (off for now).** A new setting, "Update automatically" in Settings > About, checks for a new version a minute after Updraft opens and then every 7 days, downloads it quietly, and shows "Updraft X is ready. Restart to update." On Windows the update installs when you close Updraft. It never checks, downloads or installs during a dictation, a meeting recording, a screen recording or a Voice Test. Updates are now signed, so a tampered file is never installed automatically. On the Mac it downloads, then you finish with the usual disk steps. The setting is off until it has been tried; the Check for updates button works as before.
- **Recordings tab.** Your screen recordings are listed in their own tab: play, rename, delete.
- **Pill record button and smoother hover.** The slim pill has a screen record button, grows smoothly when you hover, and the screen recording options menu now has a Record button and stays on the right screen (Windows).
